name: usage-analyzer
description: Tracks how much of a shared Claude Max or Codex plan each teammate uses, and how well they use it, on one self-hosted dashboard.

interface.shortDescription: Team usage dashboard for a shared plan
interface.longDescription: Reads your local Claude Code and Codex session logs when a session ends and pushes counts only - tokens, prompts, timestamps - to a dashboard URL you host. Everyone on the shared plan sees who used what, and which sessions were run well.
defaultPrompt: Set up usage-analyzer with my name and our dashboard URL.
Show my usage for the last 7 days.
Who used the most tokens this month?
